# anodizer acknowledgment and operation schedule

Case: CASE-096
Document control number: SPEC-0096
Effective revision: R6
Superseded revision visible in archive: R8
Subject: anodizing PO schedule
Primary measure: open outside-processing quantity
Source finished or header quantity: 67
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 EA
Unit: EA
Eligibility definition: quantity covered by the signed revised promise
Exclusion definition: received, canceled, or omitted quantity
Control: PO line, supplier operation, quantity, and acknowledged date

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000096, organization SEA, and CASE-096. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from downstream assembly and cure window; external timing is conditional on anodizer's signed promise. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
